opening.argument: The webinar ties access to OneCoin tokens to paid packages, expressly giving a EUR 1,000 purchase example and displaying packages from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000. It also makes advancement and rewards dependent on network-building: one rank requires six other ranked participants in the frontline, while those who build a network actively are promised the biggest rewards from the investment. Alongside these purchase and recruitment conditions, the presentation offers optimistic future-value projections and unusually large, time-bound earnings claims, yet the described tokens, splits, earnings, and rewards are not established as delivered or independently verified. That combination presents paid participation and recruitment-linked returns as an attractive financial opportunity without demonstrated fulfillment.
